note: Made by hand: what the test accounts still cannot show at github.com: a team asked to review (making one takes the admin:org scope, which the machine account's token does not have) and the check run of an app with a neutral conclusion (only a GitHub App makes check runs; GitHub Actions concludes success, failure, cancelled or skipped). Reviews by a second person, a pull request from a fork, real check runs and pictures learnt from commits are recorded live in ../github-org/.
hand_made: github/rest-api-description (MIT), descriptions/api.github.com, components/examples: pull-request (head.repo made hubot's fork), full-repository-default-response, commit-items, diff-entry-items, pull-request-review-items (a second review asking for changes, by hubot, copied from its item), pull-request-review-comment-items (the comment its item answers, id 8, copied from it), issue-comment-items, commit-items (GET /commits, for the pictures); GraphQL answers written after the objects of docs.github.com/en/graphql (PullRequestReviewThread, StatusCheckRollup, CheckRun from check-run-paginated, StatusContext from status).
